  # This program tracks the ledger. #

module CropPlotter = {  #› open below #
  # Crop Plotter #
  # Plant seeds on a grid, one action at a time. #

  type Plant = String;
  type Grove = [[Plant]];
  type Row = Int;
  type Col = Int;

  # The grid of planted cells, plus the seed currently selected #
  type Model = (
    grove = Grove,
    currentSeed = Plant,
    seedInventory = [Plant]
  );

  # Actions the gardener can take #
  type Action =
    + SelectSeed(Int)      # Pick a seed from the inventory #
    + PlantSeed(Row, Col)  # Plant currentSeed at a position #
    + Uproot(Row, Col)     # Clear one cell #
    + ClearGrove           # Clear every cell #
    + PlantRow(Row)        # Fill a whole row with currentSeed #;

  # Read the types above, then find the failing test (✗) below. #

  let init: Model = ⋯;  #› 9 uses #

  # Replace the cell at (row, col) with the given plant #
  let setCell = fun (grove: Grove, row: Row, col: Col, plant: Plant) -> ⋯;  #› 2 uses #

  # Fill a whole row with the given plant #
  let setRow = fun (grove: Grove, targetRow: Row, plant: Plant) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  let setAll = fun (grove: Grove, plant: Plant) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  let updateGrove = fun (m: Model, f: Grove -> Grove) -> ⋯;  #› 4 uses #

  let update = fun (m: Model, action: Action) -> ⋯;  #› 4 uses #

  let run = fun (init: Model, actions: [Action]) -> ⋯;  #› 6 uses #

    let selfcheck : () -> Bool = fun _ -> ⋯  #› 2 uses #
} in

module HarvestLedger = {
  # Night Garden Harvest Ledger #
  # Track harvests and streak bonuses #

  # ===== DATA TYPES ===== #

  # Quality tiers from the moonlit fields #
  # Higher quality = higher value multiplier #
  type Quality =
    + Bronze      # Common harvest, basic value #
    + Silver      # Good quality, moderate bonus #
    + Gold        # Excellent harvest, high value #
    + Starlight   # Legendary, highest value #;

  # Crops that grow under the night sky #
  # Each crop has a base value determined by cropValue #
  type Crop =
    + Moonmelon
    + Starfruit
    + Nightshade
    + Glowpumpkin
    + Duskwheat;

  # A single harvest from the garden #
  # Combines crop type, quality level, and quantity harvested #
  type Harvest = (
    crop = Crop,
    quality = Quality,
    quantity = Int
  );

  # The harvest ledger tracks all harvests and bonuses #
  # harvests: list of all recorded harvests (newest first) #
  # totalValue: cumulative value of all harvests plus claimed bonuses #
  # streakBonus: current unclaimed streak bonus #
  # lastQuality: quality of the most recent harvest (for streak tracking) #
  type Model = (
    harvests = [Harvest],
    totalValue = Int,
    streakBonus = Int,
    lastQuality = Quality
  );

  # Actions the farmer can take #
  type Action =
    + RecordHarvest(Harvest)  # Log a new harvest #
    + ClaimBonus              # Collect accumulated streak bonus #
    + CloseDay                # End the harvest day, reset streaks #;

  # ===== VALUE CALCULATIONS ===== #

  let cropValue = fun (c: Crop) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  let qualityMultiplier = fun (q: Quality) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Calculate the value of a single harvest #
  # Formula: baseValue * qualityMultiplier * quantity #
  let harvestValue = fun (h: Harvest) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # ===== LEDGER STATE ===== #

  # Initial empty ledger #
  # Start of a new harvest day with no recorded harvests #
  let init : Model = ⋯;  #› 17 uses #

  # ===== CORE LOGIC ===== #

  # Process a harvest action and update the ledger #
  # This function handles streak detection and bonus calculation #
  # A streak continues when consecutive harvests have the same quality #
  let processHarvest = fun (ledger: Model, h: Harvest) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Claim the streak bonus and reset it #
  # Adds current streak bonus to total, then zeroes streak #
  let claimBonus = fun (ledger: Model) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Close the harvest day - reset streak tracking #
  # Preserves harvests and total, resets streak state #
  let closeDay = fun (ledger: Model) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # ===== ACTION DISPATCH ===== #

  # Main update function - dispatch actions #
  # Routes each action type to its handler #
  let update = fun (ledger: Model, action: Action) -> ⋯;  #› 12 uses #

  # Run multiple actions in sequence #
  # Folds actions left-to-right, threading the ledger through #
  let run = fun (ledger: Model, actions: [Action]) -> ⋯;  #› 6 uses #

    let selfcheck : () -> Bool = fun _ -> ⋯  #› 2 uses #
} in

module FieldPlotter = {
  # Moonlit Field Plotter #
  # Crops advance through growth stages #

  # Growth stages that crops progress through #
  # Each stage represents a phase in the plant's lifecycle: #
  # Seed -> Sprout -> Growing -> Mature -> ReadyToHarvest #
  type GrowthStage =
    + Seed           # Just planted, dormant #
    + Sprout         # First leaves emerge #
    + Growing        # Building strength #
    + Mature         # Fully developed #
    + ReadyToHarvest # Ready to pick #;

  # Crops that flourish in the night garden #
  type CropKind =
    + Moonmelon
    + Nightshade
    + Starfruit
    + Glowpumpkin
    + Duskwheat;

  # A cell can be empty or contain a planted crop #
  type Cell =
    + Empty
    + Planted(CropKind, GrowthStage);

  # Row and column indices #
  type Row = Int;
  type Col = Int;

  # The garden field is a 2D grid of cells #
  type Field = [[Cell]];

  # The model tracks the field and gardener state #
  type Model = (
    field = Field,
    currentSeed = CropKind,
    dayCount = Int
  );

  # Actions the moonlit gardener can take #
  type Action =
    + PlantCrop(Row, Col)      # Plant currentSeed at position #
    + HarvestCrop(Row, Col)    # Harvest if ReadyToHarvest #
    + WaterField               # Advance all planted crops one stage #
    + PassDay                  # Let time flow #
    + SelectSeed(CropKind)     # Choose which crop to plant next #;

  # Read the types and comments above to get a feel for the program, #
  # then scroll down to the tests and find the failing one (✗). #

  let isPlanted = fun (cell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 5 uses #

  # Check if a crop is ready to harvest #
  # Only ReadyToHarvest crops can be harvested #
  let isHarvestable = fun (cell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  let getStage = fun (cell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 5 uses #

  # Each watering should move the plant to the next stage #
  let advanceStage = fun (stage: GrowthStage) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Apply watering to a single cell - advances stage if planted #
  let waterCell = fun (cell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Water the entire field - advance all planted crops by one growth stage #
  let waterField = fun (field: Field) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Get a cell from the field at (row, col) #
  let getCell = fun (field: Field, row: Row, col: Col) -> ⋯;  #› 11 uses #

  # Update a cell at position (row, col) with a new value #
  let setCell = fun (field: Field, targetRow: Row, targetCol: Col, newCell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 2 uses #

  # Create an empty n x m field #
  let makeField = fun (rows: Int, cols: Int) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Initialize the garden model with a 4x4 field #
  let init : Model = ⋯;  #› 11 uses #

  # Plant a crop at the given position #
  # Only plants if the cell is empty #
  let plantAt = fun (model: Model, row: Row, col: Col) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Harvest a crop at the given position #
  # Only harvests if the crop is ReadyToHarvest #
  let harvestAt = fun (model: Model, row: Row, col: Col) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

  # Update the model based on an action #
  let update = fun (model: Model, action: Action) -> ⋯;  #› 3 uses #

  # Run multiple actions in sequence #
  let run = fun (model: Model, actions: [Action]) -> ⋯;  #› 9 uses #

  # Count all planted crops #
  let countPlanted = fun (field: Field) -> ⋯;  #› 2 uses #

  let getCropKind = fun (cell: Cell) -> ⋯;  #› 1 use #

    let selfcheck : () -> Bool = fun _ -> ⋯  #› 2 uses #
} in

#› open entries, in full #
#› open: GroveNames/grove_name #
# Extracts the first section from a garden path. #
let grove_name = fun (path: String) ->
  let parts = string_split("/", path) in
  let named = filter(parts, fun s -> string_length(s) > 0) in
  case named
  | [] => ""
  | first :: _ => first
  end

#› open: CropPlotter #
module CropPlotter = {
  # Crop Plotter #
  # Plant seeds on a grid, one action at a time. #

  type Plant = String;
  type Grove = [[Plant]];
  type Row = Int;
  type Col = Int;

  # The grid of planted cells, plus the seed currently selected #
  type Model = (
    grove = Grove,
    currentSeed = Plant,
    seedInventory = [Plant]
  );

  # Actions the gardener can take #
  type Action =
    + SelectSeed(Int)      # Pick a seed from the inventory #
    + PlantSeed(Row, Col)  # Plant currentSeed at a position #
    + Uproot(Row, Col)     # Clear one cell #
    + ClearGrove           # Clear every cell #
    + PlantRow(Row)        # Fill a whole row with currentSeed #;

  # Read the types above, then find the failing test (✗) below. #

  let init: Model = (
    grove = [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""]
    ],
    currentSeed = "🌱",
    seedInventory = ["🌱", "🌿", "🍄", "☘️", "🌸"]
  );

  # Replace the cell at (row, col) with the given plant #
  let setCell = fun (grove: Grove, row: Row, col: Col, plant: Plant) ->
    mapi(grove, fun (i, r) ->
      if i == row
      then mapi(r, fun (j, c) ->
        if j == col
        then plant
        else c)
      else r);

  # Fill a whole row with the given plant #
  let setRow = fun (grove: Grove, targetRow: Row, plant: Plant) ->
    mapi(grove, fun (i, row) ->
      if i == targetRow
      then map(row, fun _ -> plant)
      else row);

  let setAll = fun (grove: Grove, plant: Plant) ->
    map(grove, fun row -> map(row, fun _ -> plant));

  let updateGrove = fun (m: Model, f: Grove -> Grove) ->
    (
      grove = f(m.grove),
      currentSeed = m.currentSeed,
      seedInventory = m.seedInventory
    );

  let update = fun (m: Model, action: Action) ->
    case action
    | SelectSeed(idx) =>
        (
          grove = m.grove,
          currentSeed = nth(m.seedInventory, idx),
          seedInventory = m.seedInventory
        )
    | PlantSeed(row, col) =>
        updateGrove(m, fun g -> setCell(g, row, col, m.currentSeed))
    | Uproot(row, col) =>
        updateGrove(m, fun g -> setCell(g, row, col, ""))
    | ClearGrove =>
        updateGrove(m, fun g -> setAll(g, ""))
    | PlantRow(row) =>
        updateGrove(m, fun g -> setRow(g, row, m.currentSeed))
    end;

  let run = fun (init: Model, actions: [Action]) ->
    fold_left(actions, fun (m, a) -> update(m, a), init);

    let selfcheck : () -> Bool = fun _ ->
      (
    let m = update(init, PlantSeed(0, 0)) in
    m.grove == [
      ["🌱", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = update(init, PlantSeed(1, 1)) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "🌱", ""],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = update(init, PlantRow(1)) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["🌱", "🌱", "🌱"],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [SelectSeed(1), PlantSeed(2, 2)]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", "🌿"]
    ]
    && m.currentSeed == "🌿"
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [PlantRow(1), Uproot(1, 1)]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["🌱", "", "🌱"],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [PlantSeed(1, 1), ClearGrove]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [
      PlantRow(0),
      SelectSeed(2),
      PlantSeed(1, 1)
    ]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["🌱", "🌱", "🌱"],
      ["", "🍄", ""],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [SelectSeed(4), PlantSeed(1, 2)]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["", "", ""],
      ["", "", "🌸"],
      ["", "", ""]
    ]
      )
      && (
    let m = run(init, [
      PlantSeed(0, 0),
      PlantRow(2),
      SelectSeed(3),
      PlantSeed(1, 1),
      Uproot(2, 2)
    ]) in
    m.grove == [
      ["🌱", "", ""],
      ["", "☘️", ""],
      ["🌱", "🌱", ""]
    ]
    && m.currentSeed == "☘️"
      )
} in
